   - Live Production App: https://edu-nexa-beta.vercel.app/
   - End-to-end multi-tenant institutional operations platform.
   - Modules: Digital student admissions, automated PDF fee vouchers & billing ledger, biometric/manual attendance with parent SMS alerts, examination grading engine (GPA/report cards), and role-based portals (Super Admin, Principal, Accountant, Teacher, Parent).
   - Performance: Under 3-second voucher generation batch latency, 80% administrative time savings.

2. **PharmaLogic ERP (Pharmacy POS & Healthcare Inventory System):**
   - High-speed pharmacy management, barcode checkout, and distributor accounting ERP.
   - Modules: FEFO (First-Expiry-First-Out) batch tracking with 30/60/90-day expiry warning alarms, sub-500ms barcode scanning, thermal receipt printing, low-stock auto-replenishment notifications, distributor credit/debit ledger, and gross/net profit margin analytics.
   - Performance: Sub-500ms checkout response, zero expired stock waste.
